description: This file defines an enumeration LogLevel representing different logging levels with associated string identifiers and utility methods for retrieval.

classes.name: LogLevel
classes.description: An enum representing various log levels (OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE, ALL) with string identifiers and methods for lookup and retrieval of identifiers.

methods.name: forIdentifier
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional<LogLevel> matching the given string identifier, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Instance method that returns the string identifier associated with the LogLevel.
